notes:
Background: mid-market B2B SaaS (customer success/product analytics). Primary goal: replace slow keyword search with semantic search across help center + in-app docs and to power embeddings for semantic recommendations. Evaluating Redwood Hosted API as quick path, then Dedicated reserved capacity for consistent nightly batch embedding jobs and predictable read qps.

Technical requirements / paraphrase from calls:
- Workloads: mixed: high read qps (search) during daytime (target 400-600 qps), heavy nightly batch embedding job (1M+ docs / night), occasional large reindex (3-4M chunks).
- Vector DB: currently piloting Pinecone but open to self-hosted vector DB; wants a validated connector and operational playbook (indexing throughput, backfill patterns, retry semantics).
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile < 120ms for semantic search responses (embedding+knn pipeline target).
- Cost profile: sensitive to per-embedding and per-query token pricing; looking for batching, caching, and quantization recommendations to lower unit costs. \"Must show $/search at scale.\"
- Model preferences: open models preferred to avoid model license costs; will evaluate a 13B quantized variant vs larger hosted model for quality tradeoffs. Keen on fallbacks: hosted cheaper variant -> dedicated higher-capacity model for peak.
- Security/compliance: SSO/SAML integration required for console access; SOC2 required, audit logs and per-request tracing desired; data residency for EU customers (some customers require EU region only). KMS for key wrapping.

POC scope agreed: 3-week technical POC. Week1: baseline throughput tests on Hosted API (single model, 13B quantized) with synthetic traffic; Week2: integrate with Pinecone index + stress test write rates and query fanout; Week3: run nightly embed batch at scale, measure cost, and test dedicated pool failover plan.

Quote from Head of Product: \"We need predictable costs and predictable latency. If Redwood can show us predictable per-search economics and a clear devops story for index backfills, this will be a budgeted line item.\"

Sales/Commercial: LumenCrest prefers annual reserved commit model for Dedicated but needs elasticity for spikes. Pricing blocker: clear per-nightly-batch pricing and dedicated pool overprovision rules.

Internal AE notes: prioritize getting PCI-like security doc and Pinecone connector benchmark. SE (Priya) to deliver nightly batch runbook and two cost scenarios (hosted vs dedicated) by 2026-03-16.
pitch_summary: Mid-market SaaS evaluating Hosted -> Dedicated for embeddings + semantic search. Needs predictable latency at 400-600 qps, 1M+ nightly batch embeddings, Pinecone integration, VPC/KMS security. High probability expansion if POC validates throughput and cost model.
negotiation_notes: Requested committed QPS tiers and burst policy. Asked for a dedicated pool trial month at reduced rate. Wants clause for auto-fallback to hosted models if dedicated pool saturated. Legal asked for data processing addendum (DPA).
win_criteria: nightly batch embed completes within maintenance window (<=6 hours)
TCO shows >=30% cost reduction vs current baseline after batching/quantization
